description: Building and operating the AI systems behind a financial literacy learning platform for college students.
bullets: Designed and built an end-to-end agentic RAG chatbot on Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI and Azure App Services, delivering a financial literacy assistant inside the learning management system.
Implemented a multi-step FERPA guardrail system combining Presidio PII scanning, LLM-as-judge review and confidence scoring, so students cannot expose private data to the chatbot.
Instrumented the full request path with the OpenTelemetry SDK into Azure AI Foundry Tracing and Application Insights, emitting a span for every step a user question passes through.
Hardened the client for accessibility and cross-device use — theme toggles, keyboard navigation, resilient state management and API guardrails.
Worked across graphic designers, backend and frontend developers, community ambassadors and finance scriptwriters to architect a scalable, user-centered platform.

description: Curated and validated the training data and model output behind a global supply chain risk graph.
bullets: Validated and curated large-scale supply chain relationship graphs covering millions of global company dependencies across supplier, customer, OEM, SaaS, PaaS, parent and subsidiary linkages.
Performed high-precision entity resolution and relationship verification, correcting automated extraction errors to improve graph accuracy and reliability for downstream ML models.
Labeled real-world disruption events — cyber incidents, geopolitical restrictions, natural disasters, sanctions, bankruptcies — to build high-quality supervised training datasets.
Ran human-in-the-loop model validation on ML-generated risk scores, dependency paths and disruption propagation predictions, feeding structured feedback into retraining pipelines.
Executed error analysis across graph-ML and NLP pipelines to identify systematic failure modes and recommend corrective labeling strategies.

org: Grand Valley State University, College of Computing
description: Supported an information visualization course while doing research in the Innovative AI and Data Science Research Lab.
bullets: Built a convolutional neural network over spatial-temporal crime data as a research assistant in the Innovative AI and Data Science Research Lab, explaining the model's inner workings through interactive visualizations.
Assisted an information visualization course built around Tableau, Vega-Lite and D3.js, covering assignments and labs.
Held office hours for visualization questions and graded graduate assignments, projects and lab work on schedule.
Made rubrics accessible and understandable so students could follow standard operating procedures in lab assignments.

org: Grand Valley State University, International Admissions and Recruitment
description: Front-line support for international applicants navigating admissions and the F-1 visa process.
bullets: Respond to 80–100 daily inquiries across the International Admissions Slate inbox and WhatsApp, covering application, admission and immigration questions.
Guide prospective international students through the full admissions and visa process, ensuring compliance with U.S. immigration policy and institutional requirements.
Build and deliver presentations for international recruitment webinars and F-1 visa mock interview sessions.
Organize and facilitate virtual mock visa interviews, improving applicant preparedness and visa approval outcomes.
Communicate program requirements, financial documentation guidelines and immigration updates across an applicant pool spanning 20+ countries.

org: Grand Valley State University, College of Computing

bullets: Partnered with the International Student Engagement Coordinator on strategies to connect international students with the wider campus and off-campus community.
Analyzed student data to understand demographic makeup and tailor support to actual student needs.
Organized college-wide events with other university departments, creating networking and professional development opportunities.
Mobilized international students to attend on- and off-campus events, driving a marked increase in networking event attendance among the international student population.

org: Grand Valley State University, Housing and Residence Life
description: Community leadership and crisis response for a residential floor of 60+ students.
bullets: Mediate and resolve conflicts among 60+ residents through impartiality, active listening and collaborative problem-solving.
Plan and execute 5+ community building programs per semester, handling logistics, budgeting, marketing and post-event evaluation.
Respond to crisis incidents each semester, ensuring resident safety, completing accurate documentation and connecting individuals to campus support resources.
Mentor 60+ students through one-on-one meetings and group interactions, supporting academic success and personal growth.
Collaborate with a 10-member RA staff team while balancing full-time graduate coursework and a graduate assistantship.

description: Leading the GVSU chapter of a student organization supporting international students.
bullets: Lead an executive board of 5 officers running the chapter.
Coordinate communication and collaboration with IFI Grand Rapids and its volunteers.

Connect international students to on- and off-campus resources so they can settle into life while studying in the USA.
